c74object.name: evi.pan~
c74object.description: Pan input(s) to output(s) using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'.

inlet.description: Pan input(s) to output(s) using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'. 0.5 = center.

objarg.name: pan
objarg.description: Initial Pan value 0..1. If mode == 1 this value represents the 1st of 2 Pan values, otherwise it is the only Pan value.

objarg.name: pan2
objarg.description: If the 2nd argument is float it represents the 2nd Pan value (only used if mode == 1), otherwise if the 2nd argument is integer it represents mode.

objarg.name: mode
objarg.description: 'Mode' can only be a typed in argument and is not dynamic. If the 2nd argument is integer it represents mode, otherwise if the 2nd argument is float an integer representing mode must be the third argument. Mode switches between mono and stereo inputs for the object. If mode == 1 new inlets appear for the additional inputs.

method.name: float
method.description: If 'mode' == 0 (the default):In right inlet, the Pan value 0..1If 'mode' == 1:In middle right inlet, the left Pan value 0..1In right inlet, the right Pan value 0..1

method.name: signal
method.description: If 'mode' == 0 (the default):In left inlet, the audio signal to be PannedIn right inlet, the Pan value 0..1If 'mode' == 1:In left inlet, the left audio signal to be PannedIn middle left, the right audio signal to be PannedIn middle right inlet, the left Pan value 0..1In right inlet, the right Pan value 0..1

attribute.name: pan1
attribute.description: Pan value 0..1. If mode == 1 this value represents the left of 2 Pan values, otherwise it is the only (mono) Pan value.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: mode can only be a typed in attribute and is not dynamic.
